content_zh:
第一卷第1章开局成为女帝炉鼎！
“好俊的男人！”
“林尘，你考虑一下，要不要与我结为道侣！”
一位绝美女子，坐在溪边。
远处青山秀美，流水叮咚，四周有一片灰蒙蒙的雾气，景色看不真切，仿若梦幻。
她名为玲珑女帝，眉目如画，肤若凝脂，头戴凤冠，身披金色凤袍，娇躯散发出一缕清香，腰间系着一根玉带，小蛮腰盈盈一握，修长白皙的双腿在林尘眼前晃动，小脚泡在溪水之中，闪闪发光。
“不必考虑了，我拒绝！”
林尘，年方十四，血气方刚，面对绝美女帝诱惑，很难不心动。
但，女帝说得好听，要与他结为道侣，其实就是想让他当炉鼎。
两人刚认识不久，哪来的感情。
林尘怕被女帝榨干，凄惨而死，而且他还有未婚妻的，所以果断拒绝！
“很好！”
玲珑女帝说完，突然一把按住林尘，将其压在身下。
“你干嘛……”
林尘剧烈挣扎，但毫无办法，眼睁睁看着玲珑女帝为所欲为。
……
三个时辰后。
场面凌乱，溪水边，凤袍、玉带、腿环，各种女子衣物首饰散落一地，水花四溅。
林尘苏醒过来，刚睁开眼，便看到一张精致绝美的脸。
玲珑女帝居高临下，脸色微红，眼眸如水，浑身散发出强大的气息。

刚才一番交流，玲珑女帝似乎更强了！
她是帝境强者，实力强大无比，曾以一己之力在域外对抗魔族百万大军，斩杀九位盖世魔君，风华绝代。
但，那一战，玲珑女帝也受了重伤，身中魔阴毒，一直无法治愈，再拖延下去，会有性命之忧。
她藏匿于玲珑塔内，横跨诸天，寻找拥有至阳体质之人，为其疗伤续命。
垂死之际，她遇到林尘，发现林尘乃是神龙体，神龙体至刚至阳，可以助她化解魔阴毒，恢复实力，甚至更进一步，突破往日巅峰！
虽说是初次见面，但情况紧急，玲珑女帝也顾不得许多，且，她对林尘的第一印象还不错。
于是，她迫不及待，将林尘抓到玲珑塔内，取其阳元。
此刻，玲珑女帝披上凤袍，赤着玉足，脚踏莲花而起，漂浮在半空之中，浑身紫气萦绕，如九天仙子，清冷，高傲。
“小家伙，现在你有两个选择，第一，留下来陪我，第……”
“我选第二！”
玲珑女帝还没说完，林尘快速打断。
content_en:
Volume 1 Chapter 1 Begins as the Empress’ Cauldron!
"What a handsome man!"
"Lin Chen, please think about whether you want to become a Taoist partner with me!"
A beautiful woman was sitting by the stream.
There are beautiful green mountains in the distance, the sound of running water, and a gray mist all around. The scenery is unreal, like a dream.
Her name was Linglong Empress, with picturesque features and creamy skin. She wore a phoenix crown and a golden phoenix robe. Her delicate body exuded a ray of fragrance. There was a jade belt tied around her waist, and her waist was slim and slender. Her slender white legs swayed in front of Lin Chen's eyes, and her little feet were soaked in the stream, sparkling.
"Don't think about it, I refuse!"
Lin Chen was fourteen years old and full of vigor. It was hard not to be tempted by the temptation of a beautiful queen.
However, the empress said nicely that she wanted to become a Taoist couple with him, but she actually wanted him to be a furnace.
The two had just met, so where did their feelings come from?
Lin Chen was afraid of being squeezed out by the Empress and dying miserably, and he also had a fiancée, so he decisively refused!
"Very good!"
After Empress Linglong finished speaking, she suddenly held Lin Chen down and pinned him down.
"What are you doing..."
Lin Chen struggled fiercely, but had no choice but to watch helplessly as Empress Linglong did whatever she wanted.
…
Three hours later.
The scene was messy. By the stream, phoenix robes, jade belts, leg rings, and various women's clothing and jewelry were scattered on the ground, with water splashing everywhere.
Lin Chen woke up and as soon as he opened his eyes, he saw an exquisite and beautiful face.
The Linglong Empress stood condescendingly, her face was reddish, her eyes were like water, and she exuded a powerful aura.
After the exchange just now, Empress Linglong seems to be stronger!
She is an emperor-level expert with extremely powerful strength. She once fought against a million-strong army of demons outside the territory and killed nine unparalleled demon kings with unparalleled magnificence.
However, in that battle, Empress Linglong was also seriously injured, and she was infected with demonic poison that could not be cured. If she continued to delay, her life would be in danger.
She hides in the Linglong Tower and travels across the heavens, looking for people with a perfect Yang constitution to heal their wounds and prolong their lives.
When she was dying, she met Lin Chen and discovered that Lin Chen was in the body of a divine dragon. The divine dragon body was extremely strong and yang, which could help her resolve the evil poison, restore her strength, and even go one step further to reach her previous peak!
Although it was their first meeting, the situation was urgent and Empress Linglong didn't care much. Moreover, her first impression of Lin Chen was not bad.
So, she couldn't wait to catch Lin Chen in Linglong Tower and take his Yang Yuan.
At this moment, the Linglong Empress put on her phoenix robe, bare her jade feet, and stood up with lotus flowers on her feet, floating in the mid-air, with purple energy lingering all over her body, like a nine-day fairy, cold and proud.
"Little guy, now you have two choices. First, stay with me, and second..."
"I choose second!"
Before Empress Linglong finished speaking, Lin Chen quickly interrupted.
